development_notes: Pre-freeze metadata checker hash-scope assertions were corrected to match producer canonical_hash(full_camera); no scientific recipe or decoded-data inspection occurred.
interpretation_limits: Vanilla splats are not verified surfaces. Native expected/median and per-contributor ray-plane depths are proposal/support, not GT.
topk_w stores raw alpha*T sorted descending; topk IDs preserve original PLY row identities; four contributors are truncated evidence.
Raster and ray-plane normals are not GT surface normals; no covariance-axis normals are computed.
Source reports historical Mic B/C dense grille/interior texture and arc crops; no new pixels viewed here.
Previous source production integrity and TRAIN qualification do not imply new fixed3D scientific success.
No old curve asset was loaded or used.
method: Independent Python standard-library JSON/ZIP/NPY-header inspection and chunked SHA256; no numpy array loading, PIL/OpenCV decoding or image tool.

native_camera_convention.depth: Camera-Z: native ray-plane t is multiplied by rln = 1/sqrt(x_normalized^2+y_normalized^2+1) for depth, median_depth and topk_depth. Expected depth is alpha*T weighted mean; moment2 is unnormalized weighted second camera-Z moment. No GT surface claim.
native_camera_convention.transform: camera_xyz = world_xyz @ w2c[:3,:3].T + w2c[:3,3]; positive camera Z projects via native_K; integer pixel centers, principal (W-1)/2.

source_read_scope: Required original REPORT/FINAL/CAMERAS/STORAGE_MAP, Mic seals/source metadata, inherited raster I/O/adapter/camera convention source; NPZ values and PNG/MP4 pixels not decoded.
